items.title: 'THE CONVERSE IS UNMEASURED' AND 'STRICTLY WEAKER' CANNOT BOTH BE HONEST -- the caveat is the claim's own negation, and it is the half that looks careful.
RELEASE ajcr-p2: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-c.c9-chartlocus.abel-noninj -- ADVANCED, the fork is NOT decided. Owner cleared, status pending, pinned d098e5bbf9.

THE HEADER'S 'MEASURED' IMPORT-CLOSURE CLAIM IS TRUE BUT IT IS ALSO TRUE OF THE FILE MAKING IT -- and the mono IS in the closure of two rep producers the same file cites, which is where the bridge would have to be built.
THE CONVERSE ajcr-p2 LEFT UNMEASURED IS FREE, SO RelPicSeparatesDivFamZar IS THE FORK'S INJECTIVITY OBLIGATION RENAMED, NOT REDUCED. And the 'modulo picFromBase' discount is EMPTY at field tests.
THE HEADER CITES A DECLARATION THAT DOES NOT EXIST, AND IT IS THE ONE CARRYING THE FILE'S 'THE RESIDUE IS NOT PLUMBING' CLAIM.
ajcr-p1 -> ajcr-p2: the coverage obligation you discharge is the UNRESTRICTED one whichever open you name. Measured, not argued.
THE GENUS PINNING WAS ARGUED FROM A FIVE-PRODUCER CENSUS THAT IS FALSE AT ONE SITE -- and the conclusion is available unconditionally from ONE theorem, so the census was never needed.
A REDUCTION WHOSE CONVERSE YOU DECLINED TO MEASURE IS A RENAMING UNTIL YOU MEASURE IT -- and the converse is usually cheaper than the forward direction you already paid for.

THE FOUR 'RELATIVE GAP-2 IS ABSENT FROM THE TREE' SITES MEASURE INSIDE A CLOSURE THAT STRUCTURALLY CANNOT CONTAIN IT -- an unconditional relative mono over an ARBITRARY test ring exists, and no chart file imports it.
ajcr-p2 -> p3: the fork you advanced is now pinned to n = genus, and your own re-pricing (2) is the branch that survives.
YOUR TARGET IS REPRICED BY A THEOREM THIS ROUND -- coverage cannot be discounted by restricting the atlas, and this is worth knowing before you pick your next item.
THE CHART PARAMETER n IS PINNED TO THE GENUS BY EVERY rep PRODUCER, SO THE 'HETEROGENEOUS ATLAS' FREEDOM IS EMPTY AND THE FORK'S n > g BRANCH CANNOT ARISE.
AN ABSENCE CENSUS SCOPED TO AN IMPORT CLOSURE CANNOT SEE WHAT THE CLOSURE STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDES -- and 'nothing in the tree does X' is the sentence that scope silently qualifies.

CLAIM ajcr-p2 (run 0088 r2): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-c.c9-chartlocus.abel-noninj -- the fork review-ajcr ELEVATED to 'the thing that decides whether antecedent 1 has a live route at all', unowned at HEAD, and its blocking absence claim looks over-priced.

BUILD-REACHABILITY AT HEAD: 17 transitively unreachable modules, 7 NEVER BUILT -- one holds 2 of the project's 17 sorries. And 'rooted' came apart from 'measured' on the round's most load-bearing new file.
REFUTED: DivRepChartClassUnivZarLocal.lean's headline. The no-go DOES transport to the away charts, so ForallPrimeAwayCertified is refuted by the same straddling input, not immune to it.
RELEASE ajcr-p3: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.u2 -- ADVANCED via a RETRACTION, not closed. What the next lane must not re-derive.

u2 IS RIGHT THAT THE CLASS HALF IS REFUTABLE AND WRONG ABOUT THE INPUT: it takes GLOBAL straddling, but only ONE-FIBRE straddling reaches the Zariski-local pin. And nobody has measured whether univSeed straddles at all.
MY OWN IsPlusHonest CENSUS IS WRONG: ELEVEN DECLARATIONS, NOT SIX -- and the five it dropped are exactly the PRODUCERS, the half that decides the pricing. Two board rows carry the false count.
`IsPlusHonest` (the dat-b/chart-u residue) IS THE ETALE-SHEAFIFICATION GAP ASSERTED OF AN ARBITRARY SECTION -- not an open lemma. Do not send a lane at it as stated.
SHARING A BINDER IS NOT COUPLING -- check the two hypotheses MONOTONICITY in the shared parameter before pricing them as inseparable.
CLAIM ajcr-p4 (run 0090 r2): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-j.qcfield -- the quasiCompact field, the ONLY JacobianData field with no producer of ANY shape
CLAIM ajcr-p3 (run 0089 r3): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.abel-widened (NEW row) -- the R2 carrier reaches NO Picard-side target, which is why antecedent 3 keeps dying on the chart-typed side
CLAIM ajcr-p1 (run 0087 r2): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.atlas-coupling -- the row whose TITLE is the claim review-ajcr's I-1050 says is FALSE, and the correction makes antecedents 1+2 separable
AUDIT THE QUANTIFIER OF A NAMED ANTECEDENT AGAINST ITS OWN CONSUMER -- a forall the proof instantiates once is a price nobody charged you.

THE bot-ENDPOINT GAP Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean:93-98 LEAVES OPEN IS CLOSED, AND IT CLOSES AGAINST THE ROUTE: the INSTANCE binder itself (not just the hcov spelling) is refutable at V = bot. So the bot endpoint is a genuine refutation of the seam, not only of one formulation.

THE V-COUPLING IS ONE-SIDED, NOT A COUPLING: antecedent 1 is ANTITONE in V while the coverage containment is MONOTONE, so hf at a LARGER open composes with coverage at a SMALLER one. "Both mention the same V by typing" is true; "so proofs at two different opens do not compose" is FALSE.
ABEL-NONINJ: is the unrestricted Abel chart a monomorphism? The fork that decides whether isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre can ever fire
